target_customer: Hospitals and health systems that buy clinical pathways and the eCART early warning tool for clinicians
problem: Clinicians vary in how they treat similar patients and miss early signs of deterioration. AgileMD delivers evidence based pathways and predictive alerts inside the EHR workflow.
business_model: B2B SaaS licensed to hospitals and health systems
product_category: Clinical decision support and predictive analytics

founders.name: Borna Safabakhsh
education: MBA, University of Chicago Booth School of Business
founders.background_notes: YC page lists MBA from Chicago Booth and awards from the University of Chicago and the Illinois Technology Foundation. Prior employers not listed.

founders.name: Scott Stern
prior_employers: University of Chicago Pritzker School of Medicine
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch April 2012 names Dr. Scott Stern as co-founder and Assistant Dean of technology and innovation at the Pritzker School of Medicine.

technical_complexity.rationale: Authoring tools for clinical pathways and later EHR integration and FDA cleared predictive models are demanding, though the first 2012 product was an HTML5 web app of decision trees.

defensibility.rationale: Pathways embedded in hospital workflows, EHR integrations and an FDA cleared eCART product are hard for a new entrant to replicate quickly. The 2012 starting product was easy to copy, so this rating reflects later position.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: EHR vendors added native decision support over time. AgileMD remained independent and, per its site, serves 500 plus hospitals and 220 thousand plus users.

market_need_then: TechCrunch in April 2012 described medical reference apps as more or less an eTextbook and positioned visual tree guidelines with real time differential diagnosis as a faster alternative. Early demand evidence was competition wins and Rock Health backing, not revenue.

branding.domain_note: Uses agilemd.com. AGILEMD trademark filed March 2013 and registered July 2016 by AgileMD, Inc. per a trademark listing.

rebrands.why: Not stated in sources opened; sources show both names, with Agile Diagnosis used in April 2012 coverage and AgileMD in later records

branding.community_and_virality: No evidence of community or merch. Health system pages such as UCHealth describe pathways built with AgileMD.

brand_strength.rationale: Known among hospital quality and informatics buyers, but a generic Agile plus MD name with no brand asset found in sources.

outcome_analysis: AgileMD started as Agile Diagnosis in YC Summer 2011 and Rock Health, raised 150 thousand dollars in convertible debt and then about 2 million dollars in 2012. It grew into an EHR integrated pathways business with an FDA cleared early warning product and says it serves over 500 hospitals. No later round or exit is confirmed, so the record shows durable independent growth on modest disclosed funding.
notes: The MobiHealthNews page returned 403, so the 2 million dollar seed with Rock Health and the conflict (a regulatory filing showing 2 million versus a founder comment of 2.5 million) rely on a search summary of that article; amount recorded as 2 million, 2.5 million is unconfirmed. The 150 thousand dollar convertible debt from SV Angel and Start Fund is from TechCrunch April 3, 2012. Round 1 stage is other because it was convertible debt. A Seedtable summary says Dr. Dana Edelson co-founded the company; not recorded because I did not open a primary source. Competitors: TechCrunch names none and CB Insights lists only recent rivals, so the list is empty.
